script_text: Stop, Leo — this is not a gentle nudge; your 12th House lit a flare. Mars retrograde is conjunct Jupiter in Cancer in your 12th House, stirring old resentment, fatigue, and unfinished private business behind the scenes. Your ruling Sun in Gemini, Leo's Fire ruler, trines the Moon in Aries in your 9th House, so speak before you overpromise. In love, Venus in your 12th House trines Neptune in Pisces in the 8th: taken Leo, expect a private confession; single Leo, attract someone spiritual, unavailable, or healing. Career and money hit your 10th House: Uranus in Taurus pushes a sudden offer, title change, or invoice correction, while the Sun in Gemini activates your 11th House network. Jupiter sextiles Saturn in Pisces in your 8th, blessing a debt, tax, or refund issue. Avoid drowning a boundary in sympathy; the gift is private support from someone who knows you. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
